prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised high-fidelity Chinese mobile homepage approval comp
Primary request: Revise the Chinese platform comp to fix four product-strategy issues while preserving its established gentle visual world. The homepage must feel like a platform that helps beginners choose a project, not a showcase of three arbitrary products.
Preserve exactly: airy warm-white composition, soft blush, powder-blue, butter-yellow and mint palette, friendly thin line icons, faint crochet-chart grid, tactile yarn and crochet details, charcoal Chinese typography, restrained rounded corners, mobile portrait proportions.
Exact hero headline: 先选喜欢的作品，选线交给我们。 Exact supporting copy: 每个作品都标清所需毛线、工具和教程，新手也能安心开始。
Exact process labels: 选择作品 → 购买材料 → 开始制作.
Replace the three specific product cards with a platform navigation titled 你想做什么？ and four equal category entries: 包袋, 围巾与披肩, 毯子, 玩偶. Use crochet-chart line illustrations, not product photos. Add a quiet secondary filter row: 热门作品, 一团完成, 礼物, 季节作品.
Replace the dark teal button with an integrated soft butter-yellow button, charcoal text and subtle coral arrow. Exact button label: 看看有哪些作品.
Bottom hint: 第一次做？从一团完成开始. Header wordmark: 毛线工作室.
Constraints: every human-readable word must be accurate Simplified Chinese. No Japanese, no English letters, no garbled characters, no extra text, no invented categories, no product names, no prices, no promotions, no watermark.
Avoid: ordinary ecommerce product grid, product cards, new-arrivals carousel, dominant single product, deep teal CTA block, random project examples, AI gradient blobs, glassmorphism and excessive pills.
